name: 29588 · Myrtle Beach, SC
findings: ZIP 29588 (Myrtle Beach) has 70 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29588 (Myrtle Beach) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 29588 (Myrtle Beach) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 34% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 49 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
